input.quote: 19.2 For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
input.rationale: The fallback elements are supplied by §§ 19.1 and 19.4: § 19.1 warrants professional and workmanlike performance and untimed material conformance of Services (defined in § 1.7 to include the hosted software) and Deliverables to their documentation, and § 19.4 gives re-performance/repair/replacement plus a refund of Fees paid. The deviation is § 19.2, which fixed a fifteen-day conformance period for Deliverables and then extinguished any correction or refund obligation after that date — below the 90-day floor and, as drafted with an unqualified cut-off read together with § 19.4's reference to "Section 19.1 or 19.2", capable of being argued to cut off correction and refund obligations generally (including for the hosted software warranted in § 19.1). Our single operation extends the period to ninety (90) days and scopes the cut-off to that Deliverable, leaving §§ 19.1, 19.3 and 19.4 verbatim. Preferred-level points we note but do not redline: no express 12-month software conformance period, and § 19.3's malicious-code warranty is narrowed to code "intentionally introduced by Vendor" (§ 19.3 does carry the Applicable Law compliance warranty).

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
mappings.quote: Vendor further warrants that Services and Deliverables will materially conform to their documentation and agreed specifications.

mappings.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
mappings.quote: Vendor warrants that Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel, in accordance with industry standards, this Agreement, and each Order Form.

mappings.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
mappings.quote: Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge.
Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it.

proposal.summary: Extend § 19.2 from fifteen to ninety (90) days and scope the post-period cut-off to that Deliverable.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our warranty floor is a ninety (90) day conformance period, so we have extended § 19.2 accordingly and scoped its cut-off to the relevant Deliverable so it cannot be read to extinguish the untimed Services and hosted-software warranties in § 19.1; the § 19.4 repair/replace and refund remedies are unchanged.

ops.oldText: For fifteen days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation.
ops.newText: For ninety (90) days after delivery, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation; after that date Vendor has no correction or refund obligation for that Deliverable.
